title: Personalized, but not private photo session
text: Was disappointed to learn when we got to the meeting place that is was a group photo session with two other families. Luckily Brayan, the photographer, was amazing and made it work without any issues. He did an excellent job making sure we all had the shots we wanted and were satisfied with the results. Plus, all the people we were gathered with were a fun and understanding group. It would have been nice to know it was group thing going into it though, none of us were notified that we would be with several other families. Thank you to Brayan for making the best out of it and making the experie
author: Amanda_A
